trigger_cases.prompt: Our engineering department of 20 devs costs $200k/month and worked across 4 initiatives in Q1. How do we calculate software capitalization and analyze our theme allocation?
Classify our sprint backlog into Capitalize vs Expense buckets using the Athenahealth framework.
Create a CSS Tailwind theme for our dark mode dashboard.
Write a unit test in Jest for an authentication JWT token validator.

binary_cases.prompt: Calculate software capitalization for a team of 10 engineers costing $100k/month working on 2 new feature projects and 2 bug/maintenance projects with 50% maintenance overhead.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must allocate project costs, classify new features as capitalized and bugs as expensed, apply the 50% maintenance deduction, and compute final capitalized amount.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
### Portfolio Allocation & Capitalization Schedule

#### 1. Allocation & Work Classification
- **Total Monthly Labor**: $100,000 (10 engineers @ $10k/mo)
- **Project Allocation**: $25,000 per project across 4 projects.

| Project | Category | Eligible for Cap | Cap Amount | Maint. Deduction (50%) | Final Capitalized |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Project 1 (New Feature) | New Feature | Yes | $25,000 | 50% | **$12,500** |
| Project 2 (New Feature) | New Feature | Yes | $25,000 | 50% | **$12,500** |
| Project 3 (Bug Fixes) | Reactive Trust | No | $0 | 50% | **$0** |
| Project 4 (Infra KTLO) | BAU / KTLO | No | $0 | 50% | **$0** |
| **Total** | | | | | **$25,000** |

#### 2. Portfolio Health Analysis
- **Capitalized Investment**: 25% ($25,000)
- **Expensed Operations**: 75% ($75,000)
- **Theme Distribution**: 50% New Innovation / 25% Bugs / 25% KTLO.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: All projects cost $100k total, so let's just capitalize 100% of engineering time.
